name: Vega C
tagline: The larger Vega: back in flight since December 2024, sold by Avio since 2025
description: Vega C is the larger Vega, built by Avio: 34.8 m tall, 3.4 m wide, 210 t at liftoff, with the P120C first stage (4,780 kN), the Zefiro 40, the Zefiro 9 and the AVUM+ upper stage. It lifts up to 2,300 kg to a 700 km sun-synchronous orbit from the Vega launch complex in French Guiana. It first flew on 2022-07-13, carrying LARES-2 and six cubesats. On VV22, on 2022-12-21 UTC, pressure fell in the Zefiro 40 and Pléiades Neo 5 and 6 were lost; the throat insert had eroded. The return to flight was VV25 on 2024-12-05, with Sentinel-1C. Avio, not Arianespace, now sells and runs its launches: VV29 in 2026 was the first it ran alone. On 2026-09-15, VV30 carried Sentinel-3C and FLEX on the 8th Vega C flight: 7 successes and 1 failure.
best_known_for: The larger Vega: back in flight since December 2024 and now sold by Avio itself
